_evidence: One message-box string as 0x00536920 reads it after 'call 0x54d1ad' (esi = [0x835846 + 4*id]): 'lodsb; cmp al,0x11; je skip; stosb; or al,al; jne' copies the bytes to 0x823200 (text) or 0x823300 (caption), dropping 0x11 (a colour/format code) and stopping after the NUL it stores. Every byte value is valid; the destinations are 0x100 apart, so a 0x40-byte source can never overrun them. Bytes 0..0x3e are drawn from NUL / 0x11 / space / letters / 0x7f / 0x80 / 0xff (NUL often, so strings of every length occur, 0x11 so the skip is taken) and byte 0x3f is the terminating NUL, so the walk never leaves the buffer. Values are synthetic.
